name: Cross-asset dual momentum
tagline: Rotates TQQQ, QQQ and BIL on multi-horizon QQQ-vs-cash and QQQ-vs-SPY momentum.
summary: Uses a 21/42-session absolute-momentum OR gate, an 84/105/126-session majority gate and a 126-session QQQ-vs-SPY relative gate, with a volatility-targeted TQQQ sleeve. Revision 1 failed and Revision 2 was built after that failure; the full record earns 30.58% CAGR while the 2024-26 holdout earns only 9.23%, making the edge a fragile 2018/2022 crash-avoidance bet.
caveat: Revision 2 was selected after Revision 1 failed on the same window, 10% of placebo shifts still beat it, and the 2024-26 holdout earns only 9.23%, so the 2018/2022 crash-avoidance edge does not generalize.
